entities.summary: Nagoya City University , abbreviated to Meishidai (名市大), is a public university in Japan. The main campus (Kawasumi) is located in Mizuho-ku, Nagoya City. Other three campuses are also located in the city. Nagoya City University is a university in Asia, established in 1950. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
